metadata.description: Official Kemory plugin for Claude Code

plugins.name: kemory
plugins.description: Persistent cross-session memory via Kemory: hooks that keep recall quality improving, a skill for using memory well, and session capture, on by default.

plugins.name: kemory-panel
plugins.description: Kemory inside Claude Code: a status line that says whether memory works, the memories in context above the prompt, transcript cards, and a panel to review, rate, save and delete memories. Auto-approves read-only Kemory tools. Requires the kemory plugin.
